findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: attestpage_verify_quote, attestpage_verify_citations, attestpage_fetch, attestpage_recheck, attestpage_check_links, attestpage_attest, attestpage_verify_document, attestpage_verify_quotes, attestpage_preview_document · Private data: attestpage_attest, attestpage_verify_document, attestpage_preview_document · Public sink: attestpage_verify_quote, attestpage_verify_citations, attestpage_fetch, attestpage_recheck, attestpage_check_links, attestpage_check_packages, attestpage_attest, attestpage_verify_document, attestpage_verify_quotes, attestpage_preview_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: attestpage_verify_quote, attestpage_verify_citations, attestpage_fetch, attestpage_recheck, attestpage_check_links, attestpage_attest, attestpage_verify_document, attestpage_verify_quotes, attestpage_preview_document · Private data: attestpage_attest, attestpage_verify_document, attestpage_preview_document · Public sink: attestpage_verify_quote, attestpage_verify_citations, attestpage_fetch, attestpage_recheck, attestpage_check_links, attestpage_check_packages, attestpage_attest, attestpage_verify_document, attestpage_verify_quotes, attestpage_preview_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
